cards.title: Clarifying Coverage for Leakages
cards.csrScript: Could you please specify the locations or systems where the leakages are occurring? This will help us determine the coverage under your ShieldPlus plan.
cards.evidence: i need to request a claim for a couple of leakages at my house.

cards.title: Clarification Needed
cards.csrScript: Could you please provide more details about the issue you're experiencing? This will help me determine the coverage under your ShieldPlus plan.

cards.title: Foundation Leak Coverage
cards.csrScript: The leak by the foundation is covered under your ShieldPlus plan if it involves covered lines or pipes within the main foundation. However, if the leak is due to external factors or involves non-covered items, it may not be covered. If access requires going through concrete, coverage is limited to $1,000 for access and rerouting.
cards.evidence: the first is a leak by the foundation outside

cards.title: Backflow Preventer Coverage
cards.csrScript: Unfortunately, issues related to the backflow preventer for the irrigation system aren't covered under your current policy because coverage for irrigation systems requires additional coverage not included in your standard plan. I can schedule a technician to assess the issue and provide an estimate if you'd like.
cards.evidence: it’s the backflow preventer for the irrigation system

cards.title: Foundation Leak Coverage
cards.csrScript: Leaks within the main foundation involving covered lines or pipes are covered under your ShieldPlus plan. If access requires going through concrete, coverage is limited to $1,000 for access and rerouting. I can schedule a technician to assess and address the issue.

cards.title: Irrigation System Backflow Preventer
cards.csrScript: Unfortunately, the backflow preventer for the irrigation system isn't covered under your plan because it requires additional coverage not included in your standard plan. I can schedule a technician to provide an estimate for repair.
cards.evidence: backflow preventer for the irrigation system

cards.title: Supply Line Coverage
cards.csrScript: Unfortunately, the supply lines under your kitchen and bar sinks aren't covered under your ShieldPlus plan because they are considered part of the plumbing system, which is excluded due to age and corrosion. I can schedule a technician to assess the repair cost and provide an estimate if you'd like.
cards.evidence: two supply lines—one under the kitchen sink and one under the bar sink. they are probably lines leaking due to age and corrosion.

cards.title: Technician Service Issue
cards.csrScript: Unfortunately, issues with a technician's service are not covered under your plan because they fall under limitations and exclusions, such as secondary costs or damages resulting from delays or neglect. I can schedule a technician to assess the situation and provide a solution.
cards.evidence: yes, normal wear and tear as mentioned by the technician.

cards.title: Technician Service Issue Coverage
cards.csrScript: If the technician cannot resolve the issue, you may need to find an outside service contractor, but this must be authorized by us first. If authorized, the contractor must provide a diagnosis and cost estimate before any work is done. We will review this and make a coverage decision.

cards.csrScript: If the issue with the technician's service is related to a covered breakdown and follows the proper service request process, it should be covered under your plan. Unauthorized services or issues outside the scope of coverage won't be reimbursed.
